title: 建築法規
subtitle: Laws and Regulations of Architecture
keywords: The role of the Building Standards Law and the composition 2.Safety of a building (element regulation) 3.The harmony with the area (restrictions for grouping) 4.Architect's obligation 5.Construction related decree
educationalGoal: When a building is made in our country, Building Standards Law is set as the standard of the floor to plan for securement of public welfare while respecting the fundamental human rights set as the Constitution of Japan. The standard which should be considered is set as the environment of the city and the area about an achieved thing, location of the building and the scale, etc. while securing the sanitary society and structure safety about beauty and the function asked from architectural space.
advice: It's explained about a building code decree and it's made only a point about architects law and a builder law and so on related decree mainly. Tuition uses a chart and an illustration much and makes an effort toward simple explanation while advancing it by a text "teaching materials for building law" and referring to statute at large. Further, the knowledge is trained by trying the exercise by which it's for an architect examination question. The item of the syllabus planning is as follows. 1.The role of the building law, 2. The construction of the construction decree and definition of terminology, 3. Calculation method of the area and the height,4. The general structure and lighting 5. Ventilation and sound insulation, 6. Wooden pillar and wall framing,7. The structural strength and structure calculation, 8.Fire resistive building and quasi-fire-proof building, 9.Restriction on interior finish, 10. Refuge facilities and smoke eliminating equipment, 11. Land use regulation of a building by use zones, 12. Relation between a road and a site building, 13. The building coverage and rate of building volume, 14. Restriction of the height, 15. Sun shadow regulation, 16. Fire-proof district and quasi-fire-preventive district, 17. District plans, 18. Procedure about construction, 19. Registered Architect Law, 20. The city planning law
requiredKnowledge: Registered Architect Law was revised in March, 2020. Without also passing through business experience about registered architect of the first class as well as the second-class architect test for which you could take an examination immediately after graduation, this change could take an examination now. A pass trains a possible force with a basic target in a building law test of second class registered architect at this session. A pass also tries a first class registered architect examination question simultaneously with that, and aims at the possible ability in a registered architect of the first class legal test.
